notes: The site is at the plans-v1 coordinate. Imagery: current Esri World Imagery (Vantor Vivid, 2023-12-18, 0.5 m), zoom 18; zoom 19 is not available. A first fit on the reservoir alone was used only to find the other features; all points were then read independently on the sheet and on the imagery. Five of the eleven points (cp7-cp11) are not on exposed masonry, so the fit without exposed masonry is also available. No statement of a wall's or a town's orientation was seen while working on this plan.
